subject: Mutual action plan: KMS escrow, phased SOC 2 evidence, SIG-Lite & DPA timing
messages:
From: Suzanne Cho <suzanne.cho@fintegrate.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@fintegrate.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & evidence intake — high level asks

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Fintegrate is excited by the latency profile and the routing/fallback story. We want to fast-track an evaluation and have two primary asks to include in a Mutual Action Plan (MAP):

1) Security/compliance gating: We need a plan for SOC 2 evidence collection (we'll accept a phased intake, not everything at once), SIG/CAIQ checklist (we can start with a SIG-Lite subset), and a mutually acceptable DPA redline deadline.

2) Data residency & retention: our legal team needs a clear retention window and the approach for key management (customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed KMS with key escrow? we need specifics).

Can you share a draft MAP that sequences the above into milestones (evidence intake checkpoints, DPA review dates, and the acceptance criteria that your security team will use)? We are aiming to finish commercial approval by Oct 20 so timelines are tight.

Appreciate a one-page MAP and a short kickoff call this week (30m).

Best,
Suzanne Cho
Head of Platform Security, Fintegrate
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Suzanne Cho <suzanne.cho@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> , Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evidence intake — high level asks

Suzanne — thanks, excited to partner on this. Attached is a first-pass MAP (Fintegrate_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short SOC 2 evidence snapshot. TL;DR: we can meet an Oct 20 commercial signoff with a phased evidence approach and a DPA redline cadence. Key points: 

- Phased SOC 2 evidence intake: Tier 1 (must-have) evidence due by Sep 30: network diagrams, encryption in transit docs, and SSAE-validated cert pointers. Tier 2 (operational) by Oct 12: incident response runbook excerpts, subprocessor list, and audit log retention samples.
- SIG-Lite: we propose starting with the 30 most relevant controls (inventory included) to accelerate review; full CAIQ can follow post-contract as a post-acceptance deliverable.
- DPA: we can accept three review rounds. Suggest soft redline deadline Oct 6, final sign-off Oct 16 to preserve Oct 20 commercial cadence.
- KMS & key escrow: two options in the MAP: (A) customer-managed CMEK via your KMS (preferred for Fintegrate) or (B) Redwood-managed KMS with HSM-backed escrow under an escrow MOU. We note that option (A) has a ~2 week provisioning lead; option (B) requires an additional escrow legal addendum.
- Retention windows: default 30 days for transient request data, configurable up to 365 days for logs/evidence; archival patterns and export tooling documented in the MAP.

Can we do a 30m sync Wed 09/22 10:00am PT? I've copied Kimberly (legal) and Marcus (security) to weigh on DPA carveouts and KMS handling.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Fintegrate_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx); SOC2_evidence_snapshot.csv (csv)
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: DPA redline & KMS options for Fintegrate (help)

Kimberly / Marcus — following up from the external thread. Points we need legal/security to confirm before Wed call: 

1) DPA carveouts: Fintegrate will push for an EU data residency clause plus a 7-day preservation hold for investigations. Can we accept 7-day preservation for incident holds and keep standard 30/365 retention tiers?
2) KMS approach: Kimberly — if they choose customer-managed CMEK, we'll need the standard onboarding checklist (IAM role, key policy, sample KMS ARNs). Marcus — any red flags operationally for CMEK vs Redwood-managed escrow? Specifically: KV cache behavior and performance impacts when customer keys are rotated.
3) SIG-Lite: I propose we pre-fill the 30 controls we expect to be asked and mark the ones requiring evidence in Tier 1. Marcus, can you add quick notes to the MAP file where we should expect SOC evidence gaps?

I'm OK with the Oct 6 soft DPA deadline and Oct 16 final, but we'd like legal to confirm. We can also offer a short tech proof (private tenant in our staging region) as a conditioning milestone in the MAP to shorten confidence checks.

If anyone is blocked on time Wed 09/22 10am PT, propose Thu 09/23 11am PT.

Thanks — Stephanie
From: Suzanne Cho <suzanne.cho@fintegrate.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@fintegrate.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP & evidence intake — high level asks

Stephanie / team — thanks for the clear MAP and for proposing options. We're aligned on the phased evidence intake and the SIG-Lite starting point. A few confirmations: 

- Wed 09/22 10am PT worked well for our security and legal teams; they prefer customer-managed CMEK and requested the KMS provisioning checklist (see procurement note).
- Procurement will complete round 1 of the DPA redline this week (expect to upload to DocuSign by 2026-10-04). We've flagged two items: EU residency clause and the 7-day preservation hold (legal prefers 14 days). We'll note those as escalation items in the MAP.
- Acceptance criteria: Fintegrate will sign contingent on completion of Tier 1 evidence and confirmation of CMEK provisioning in our staging tenant. If both are met by Oct 12, we proceed to final DPA sign-off.

Attached: procurement uploaded annotations to the MAP (we'll share the DocuSign link when ready). Looking forward to the staged intake model — that structure should help speed final approval.

Best,
Suzanne
Attachments: procurement_annotations.pdf (pdf)
